g.text: same width as the front door
clear of the swing, on purpose
scheduled beside the flight it coats
square in the front door's swing
the one fixture with an alibi
Fan art — an original drawing of a house from a 1990 film, not affiliated with it. The crayon
battle plan in the film was drawn by Macaulay Culkin himself; this one is issued instead: sheet
A-101, dated December, 12 rooms, 234.00 m². Red is the way in — back door, kitchen, the foot of
the flight. 4 is the ONE hand-written coordinate on the sheet, which is why `arch lint` reports
